name: Nasu no Yoichi
source:
Yoichi Nasuno is a new transfer student in Kawakami Academy. He was put directly in Class 2-S because of his overwhelming skills in archery.

His friends, [url=/c5867]Yoshitsune Minamoto[/url] and [url=/c5868]Benkei Musashibou[/url], also transferred to Kawakami Academy. The three clones were made by the Kuki group, and transferred to Kawakami Academy where their are assembling all prominent young fighters they found he is currently living with his friends in the Kuki Mansion.

Yoichi, Benkei and Yoshitsune were born in the same day and have been friends since young age.

Yoichi is and expert in archery, with an incredible accuracy, his ability with the bow rivals Miyako Shiina's skills.

Yoichi finds it annoying having to transferred to Kawakami Academy and work for the Kuki group, but he accepted it because Yoshitsune and Benkei have already did.

Like his friends, his name is based on a historical samurai and one of the most renowned in the Japanese culture, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasu_no_Yoichi]Nasu no Yoichi[/url], a samurai who fought in the Genpei war and was loyal to the Minamoto Clan, he served under Minamoto no Yoshitsune command and was well know for his incredible skill with the bow.

Yoichi is one of the new characters in the new sequel of Majikoi, Maji De Watashi Ni Koi Shinsai! S.

[Edited from [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Yoichi_Nasu]Majikoi's Wiki[/url]]
